# Frontend — React dashboard and marketing site

`Frontend/` is one React 19 SPA serving **two audiences**: the public marketing site at
`/` and the authenticated product at `/dashboard` (aliased `/app`), including the
platform-admin (landlord) console under `/admin/*`. Vite, Tailwind v4, TanStack Router +
Query, Zustand, Vitest.

## Commands

```bash
npm run dev          # Vite on :5173
npm run build        # tsc --noEmit && vite build
npm test             # Vitest, all layers (16 test files)
npm run test:unit | test:component | test:integration
npm run typecheck    # type-checks src AND tests (tsconfig.test.json)
```

Vitest + React Testing Library + jsdom (jsdom is pinned to 26 — v27 pulls an ESM-only
dependency that breaks Vitest's fork pool).

## Where things live

| Area | Path |
|---|---|
| Design tokens (Warm Sage) | `src/index.css` — the Tailwind v4 `@theme` block is the single source |
| UI kit | `src/components/ui/` — alert, avatar, badge, button, card, chip, empty-state, input, label, modal, page-header, query-error, select, skeleton, table |
| Shells | `src/components/AppLayout.tsx`, `AuthLayout.tsx`, `components/marketing/MarketingLayout.tsx` |
| Public marketing pages | `src/pages/marketing/` (hubs, feature/solution detail, pricing, about, faq, contact, refund policy, `marketingData.ts`) |
| Household pages | `src/pages/` (`DashboardPage`, `requests/`, `places/`, `members/`, `billing`, `recurring`, `money/`, `settings`, `feedback`) |
| Platform admin pages | `src/pages/admin/` |
| API client + error mapping | `src/lib/api.ts` |
| Route guards | `src/lib/guards.ts` |
| Domain helpers | `src/lib/{plans,money,recurring,utils}.ts` |
| Session bootstrap | `src/lib/session.ts` |
| Plan usage | `src/hooks/useQuota.ts` |
| Route tree | `src/router.tsx` (exports `routeTree` for tests) |
| Stores | `src/stores/{auth,tenant,ui}.ts` |
| Tests | `tests/{unit,component,integration}` + `tests/support` — see `TESTING.md` |

## Rules that matter here

- **Colour and type come from the theme, never hardcoded.** The Warm Sage palette and the
  `text-display-lg … text-label-sm` scale live in `src/index.css`. Radius follows
  Tailwind's defaults on purpose, so `rounded-xl` means 12px as in the design exports.
- **Tokens map 1:1 to the design files** in `../UI/` and `../stitch_cross_platform_dashboard_ui/`.
- **The public site has a static twin.** Marketing copy, pricing, feature names and refund
  policy also live in `../Website/` (`index.html`, `llms.txt`, `sitemap.xml`). A marketing
  change is not finished until both are updated.
- **The API is mocked at the module boundary, and the setup file must not import stores.**
  `tests/setup.ts` runs before `vi.mock` applies; importing a store there caches the live
  axios instance and hits the network. Reset state via `tests/support/session.ts`.
- **Await data-dependent assertions.** A page renders its header before react-query
  resolves, so use `await screen.findBy…` for anything fetched.
- **Never put a `Date.now()`-derived value in a query key.** It changes every render and
  the query refetches in a loop. Derive time windows with `useMemo` keyed on the real input.
- **Query keys are grouped by area** — `['tenant', …]`, `['platform', …]`, `['billing', …]`,
  `['ledgers', …]`, `['requests', 'board']` — and mutations invalidate the area key rather
  than refetching by hand.
- **Respect the guards.** `requireAuth` / `requireTenant` / `requirePlatformAdmin` decide
  what a route may assume; the platform admin has no tenant, so tenant-scoped UI must be
  gated on `!is_platform_admin`.
- **Server state is TanStack Query; Zustand only for what the server does not own.**
- **Plan caps come from the API.** `useQuota()` reads `GET /v1/tenant/quotas`;
  `src/lib/plans.ts` is a presentation fallback only (`capFor()`), never the authority.
- Frontend `isAdmin`-style flags must mirror the server rule exactly. When the server
  distinguishes owner from admin (see `Backend/config/roles.php`), keep two flags.

## Manual QA

Start `Backend` (`php artisan serve`) and this app, then sign in at
`http://localhost:5173/login`. The public pages need no account. Seeded accounts are in
`Backend/TESTING.md`; they all use the password `password`.
